caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical jar with a slightly wider rim at the top and a subtle ridge near the base. The jar is rendered in shades of brown, with darker mottled patches suggesting texture on the surface, and a lighter brown base. The rim has a pronounced lip, and the jar’s surface shows slight irregularities in the coloring. The jar is placed on a flat, tan surface that has subtle wood-grain patterns, and the background is a plain, light beige color. At the top of the drawing, the text "JAR – EARLY 19th CENTURY" is written in gray, uppercase letters.
title: Red Glazed Preserve Jar
